title: Chopped Cauliflower & Chickpea Salad with Maple-Curry Vinaigrette
description: A crunchy, flavorful salad with cauliflower, chickpeas, currants, and a bold maple-curry dressing. Benefits from a couple hours in the fridge before serving. Add grilled chicken to make it a meal.

ingredients.name: canned no-salt-added chickpeas (19 oz), drained and rinsed

instructions.text: Combine {0} cauliflower, {1} chickpeas, {2} carrots, {3} green peas, {4} green onions, {5} currants, and {6} cilantro in a large bowl. Mix well and set aside.

Make the dressing: whisk together {8} olive oil, {9} apple cider vinegar, {10} maple syrup, {11} Dijon mustard, {12} curry powder, {13} cumin, {14} salt, and {15} black pepper in a small bowl until combined.
Pour dressing over the salad and mix gently until everything is well coated. Add a few more grinds of black pepper.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours (or up to 1 day) before serving. The flavors improve significantly with marinating time.
Just before serving, sprinkle {7} sliced almonds over the top.

notes: Swap currants for an equal amount of chopped dates if you prefer a sweeter, richer flavor. To make this a full meal, top each serving with a sliced grilled chicken breast. Note: green peas will start to lose their vibrant color the longer the salad sits in the fridge.
